sources.title: Nemotron 3 Content Safety model card
sources.evidence: Identifies the exact Gemma-3-4B-it safety fine-tune, NVIDIA developer, merged LoRA release, March 16, 2026 release, nominal 4B total, text/image input, text labels output, 128K context and combined license terms. It explicitly supports 12 languages and 23 safety categories. Reopened October 27: explicitly says the LoRA adapter weights were merged back into the named parent Gemma-3-4B-it; no pruning, expert expansion or added modality is described.

sources.title: Exact checkpoint configuration
sources.evidence: Gemma3ForConditionalGeneration: 34 dense text layers, hidden size 2560, intermediate 10240, eight query/four KV heads with head dimension 256, vocabulary 262208, 131072 positions; 27-layer SigLIP vision encoder, hidden 1152, intermediate 4304, 896px images and 14px patches. There are 29 sliding and five full-attention text layers; no experts, routers or quantization configuration. Fresh October 27 configuration still uses Gemma3ForConditionalGeneration and the same text/vision dimensions; no separate classifier-head or adapter architecture is configured.

sources.title: Complete BF16 checkpoint index
sources.evidence: Indexes 883 tensors across five shards and reports 4300079472 parameters and 8600158944 tensor-data bytes. All indexed names were matched exactly to configuration/code-derived shapes and retrieved headers. October 27 reread of the JSON index independently reconfirms metadata.total_parameters=4300079472; no separate LoRA, classifier, expert or router entries occur in its weight map. No shard/header requests were made during this parameter pass.

sources.title: Official safetensors headers, first of five indexed shards
sources.evidence: Bounded HTTP 206 reads of bytes 0–65535 from all five indexed shards supplied complete JSON headers. All 883 tensors are BF16 learned parameters; contiguous byte offsets, shape products and index metadata agree on 4300079472. No scales, packed storage or persistent buffers counted.

sources.title: Gemma 3 implementation matching checkpoint Transformers version
sources.evidence: Defines dense text projections, four per-block norms, q/k norms and multimodal projection. The language-model output head is tied to input embeddings and counted once. Checkpoint conversion mapping handles this checkpoint’s language_model.model and vision_tower prefixes. Rotary frequencies and embedding scale are nonpersistent buffers, absent from the learned count; no sequence-classification head is present.

sources.title: SigLIP vision implementation
sources.evidence: Defines learned patch/position embeddings, 27 attention/MLP blocks and post-layernorm. vision_use_head=false excludes the pooling head. Position IDs are nonpersistent buffers. All projected dimensions and weight/bias shapes match the exact checkpoint.

sources.title: Gemma 3 configuration defaults
sources.evidence: Gemma3TextConfig defaults tie_word_embeddings to true, agreeing with the single stored embedding matrix and no separate output-weight tensor in this checkpoint.

sources.title: Exact safety-classification chat template
sources.evidence: Specialized template instructs direct User Safety/Response Safety labels and optional Safety Categories, controlled by /categories or /no_categories. There is no tool-call schema, tool response role, reasoning trace or thinking toggle. Together with model.generate usage, this confirms autoregressive textual classification rather than a separate classifier head.

sources.title: Exact model API documentation
sources.evidence: Describes the same merged multimodal safety model, nominal 4B and 128K context. Explicitly dates Hugging Face and NGC March 16, 2026, with later Build deployment April 14, 2026. Output consists of safety labels and optional categories. Reopened October 27: confirms LoRA weights merged into the named Gemma-3-4B-it base, with no separate active count.

sources.title: Nemotron 3 Content Safety introduction
sources.evidence: March 20, 2026 primary article confirms public model availability before April deployment dates, Gemma 3 backbone and two supported output modes: direct labels and labels with categories. Describes merged safety fine-tuning and multilingual/multimodal use.

sources.title: Later model comparison introducing version 3.5
sources.evidence: June 4, 2026 announcement explicitly identifies original Nemotron 3 Content Safety as the March release and describes optional reasoning traces/custom policies as additions in 3.5. It labels original version nominally 4B and supplies no separate active-parameter count. Reopened October 27 for the parameter pass; the original remains described as a 4B-parameter model.

sources.title: Nemotron 3.5 Content Safety technical report
sources.evidence: Inspected the August 2026 later technical report and comparison tables while searching for original-model active counts; it does not disclose an active-per-token count for Nemotron 3 Content Safety. Its 3.5 reasoning specifications are not transferred to this earlier model. Fresh October 27 reread of the full original report, model-selection/training sections and comparisons again found no activated-parameter column for the earlier model.

sources.title: NVIDIA Nemotron Open Model License
sources.evidence: The December 15, 2025 license linked by the exact card governs NVIDIA’s contribution and grants use/reproduction/distribution rights subject to its terms.

sources.title: Gemma Terms of Use
sources.evidence: The terms explicitly cover Gemma model derivatives and are additionally required by NVIDIA’s exact card.

sources.title: Gemma Prohibited Use Policy
sources.evidence: The exact card includes this additional policy among the governing terms.

sources.title: Exact NVIDIA Build page and embedded capability metadata
sources.evidence: The exact model’s embedded modelCapability object sets functionCalling=true and reasoning=true, conflicting with the safety-only checkpoint template and documented modes. The page identifies text/image inputs and text output, and marks the hosted endpoint deprecated; this does not remove downloadable weights.

sources.title: NIM container release dates
sources.evidence: Container card gives April 16, 2026 for Hugging Face and April 30 for Build, conflicting with the model card/API dates. The March 20 model announcement predates both; container/service dates are not used as the model’s first release.

sources.title: Pinned NVIDIA checkpoint aggregate metadata, October 27 recheck
sources.evidence: Fresh HTTP 200 metadata reports 4300079472 BF16 parameters and Gemma3ForConditionalGeneration, matching the retained exact total and fresh JSON index. cardData.base_model names google/gemma-3-4b-it. Aggregate metadata only; no weight shards downloaded.

sources.title: Qwen3 Technical Report, Table 7
sources.evidence: Freshly read original Table 7: exact Gemma-3-4B Base is listed as dense with 4B total and 4B activated parameters. This is Qwen Team's nominal research-comparison convention, not a Google or NVIDIA active-count disclosure. It is applied through the explicitly documented PT-to-IT and merged-LoRA lineage, rather than by equating dense total with active.

sources.title: Named Google Gemma 3 4B IT base metadata
sources.evidence: Fresh public metadata explicitly identifies google/gemma-3-4b-pt as base_model, reports Gemma3ForConditionalGeneration and 4300079472 BF16 parameters, matching the NVIDIA derivative and named PT model. The direct pinned Google config request was gated (401); public metadata and Google's report establish the lineage without it.

sources.title: Named Google Gemma 3 4B PT ancestor metadata
sources.evidence: Fresh HTTP 200 public metadata reports 4300079472 BF16 parameters and Gemma3ForConditionalGeneration for the exact PT ancestor named by Google's IT metadata. Matching aggregate architecture/count corroborates the documented post-training lineage; no tensor census was performed.

sources.title: Google Gemma 3 Technical Report, architecture and instruction-tuning
sources.evidence: Read architecture/Table 1 and Section 3: pretrained models become instruction-tuned models through post-training, with knowledge distillation from an IT teacher and RL fine-tuning. All models share the tokenizer; the already multimodal 4B model includes the shared SigLIP encoder. The named PT-to-IT relationship describes no resized student, pruning, expert expansion or added modality. The teacher's size is not transferred.

sources.title: Kimi-VL Technical Report, Figure 1
sources.evidence: Reopened the original report and visually inspected its original PDF page 1. Figure 1 explicitly labels Gemma-3-4B-IT at approximately 4B on the Activated Parameters (B) axis. This corroborates the nominal convention for NVIDIA's exact named base; it neither measures the NVIDIA derivative directly nor defines Gemma-specific component/phase scope. Kimi's own language-decoder qualification is not transferred to Gemma.

sources.title: Building NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Agents, content-safety section
sources.evidence: Freshly read March 24 original article calls the exact model 4B and uses the broad wording adapter-based classification head. The exact card/API instead specify a merged LoRA release; its Gemma3ForConditionalGeneration config and fresh index have no separate classifier or LoRA tensor entries. Thus this article is not evidence of additional learned structure or a separate active count.

name.note: Exact official model name; distinct from later Nemotron 3.5 and Content Safety Reasoning 4B.

developer.note: NVIDIA developed the safety fine-tune; Google supplied the Gemma base.

family.note: Official Nemotron naming; family membership does not imply the hybrid/MoE architecture of other Nemotron 3 releases.

release_date.note: Exact HF and API cards explicitly give March 16. March 20 announcement independently establishes availability before conflicting April container dates. Retain earliest documented model release, not later NIM deployment.

open_weights.note: Public merged BF16 checkpoint; bounded headers are accessible without authentication. Hosted endpoint deprecation does not revoke weight availability.

license.value: NVIDIA Nemotron Open Model License + Gemma Terms of Use
license.note: Exact card explicitly names both agreements and the Gemma Prohibited Use Policy; this descriptive value is not an unrestricted or Apache-license claim.

parameters_b.note: Retain the previously established exact complete learned count, 4.300079472B. Fresh October 27 pinned aggregate metadata and JSON index both independently report 4300079472 BF16 parameters, consistent with the prior reconstruction. This includes language, SigLIP vision encoder and projector; tied input/output embeddings count once and LoRA is already merged. NVIDIA's 4B is nominal. No shard/header reads or new tensor census were performed this pass.

active_parameters_b.note: Nominal 4B inferred through the explicitly named Gemma-3-4B-IT merged-LoRA lineage. Qwen Team's original Table 7 lists Gemma-3-4B Base at 4B activated; Google documents PT-to-IT post-training and identifies that PT ancestor, with matching architecture and aggregate totals. Kimi Team's Figure 1 independently plots exact Gemma-3-4B-IT at approximately 4B activated. NVIDIA's card/API explicitly merge LoRA into this base; the released config/index and matching total support no added classifier, pruning, expert expansion or new modality. This is an attributed nominal comparison convention transferred by documented lineage, not an NVIDIA direct disclosure or the precise total copied into active. Neither comparison defines Gemma-specific component or phase participation; exact per-token active counts remain unresolved. Fresh exact-model searches and later NVIDIA comparisons found no more precise active definition.

architecture.note: Dense Gemma 3 decoder with alternating sliding/full attention, SigLIP vision encoder and multimodal projector. No routed experts. Text classification is generated through the tied LM head, not a separate safety-classifier head.

context_window.note: Exact text configuration specifies 131072 maximum positions, matching the card’s rounded 128K context.

modalities.note: Correct baseline text-only input: exact model accepts text and an optional single image, generating safety-label text. No audio or video capability is asserted.

reasoning.note: Unresolved primary-source conflict: Build metadata says reasoning=true, but exact template and published modes emit direct safety labels; the later 3.5 announcement presents reasoning traces as an addition. Clear baseline false rather than treat a metadata flag or later variant as proof of this checkpoint’s dedicated reasoning mode.

tool_call.note: Unresolved primary-source conflict: exact Build metadata says functionCalling=true, while the specialized template/API model documentation defines safety labels and no function-call format. Clear baseline false; raw flag does not establish trained checkpoint capability.

patch.description: NVIDIA’s Gemma 3 safety fine-tune for classifying text and image inputs and model responses, with optional labels for 23 safety categories.
patch.notes: 4B is nominal; the complete merged BF16 checkpoint has exactly 4.300079472B learned parameters, including the SigLIP vision encoder and multimodal projector. Shared input/output embeddings are counted once; LoRA is already merged. Nominal 4B active is inferred through NVIDIA's merged-LoRA Gemma 3 4B IT lineage, using Qwen Team's published base-model activated-count convention and Kimi Team's exact-IT plot. This is not a direct NVIDIA active disclosure or exact per-token count; component and phase participation remain unspecified. This model accepts text and an optional single image. The March 16, 2026 model release predates later NIM/container dates. NVIDIA’s Build capability flags conflict with the safety-only checkpoint template and documented modes, leaving dedicated reasoning and tool calling unresolved. License terms also include the Gemma Prohibited Use Policy. The hosted endpoint is marked deprecated, while downloadable weights remain available.

parameter_count_reproduction.method: Reconstruct all 883 learned tensor shapes from pinned config and Transformers v4.57.6 Gemma3/SigLIP classes; reconcile index names and all five HTTP 206 bytes=0-65535 safetensors header reads. Require BF16, contiguous offsets and twice shape-product data bytes. Shared output embedding is stored once; no persistent non-parameter tensors.

summary: October 27 parameter re-audit retains exact 4.300079472B total, freshly confirmed by pinned aggregate metadata and JSON index, and establishes nominal 4B active by explicit merged-LoRA Gemma 3 4B IT lineage. Qwen Team Table 7 supplies the PT activated-count convention, Google documents PT-to-IT post-training, and Kimi Team Figure 1 corroborates exact IT at approximately 4B. Matching released architecture/totals and no separate head or adapter support the nominal transfer. No direct NVIDIA active definition or exact phase/component participation was found. No weight shards were read; the other 12 field assessments and prior exact-count reproduction are preserved.
